description: This topic explores the value and dignity of work, types of work, self-reliance and self-employment, basic entrepreneurship, and the wise use of time and resources for individual and national development.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following best describes the meaning of work?

options.text: Any activity that wastes a person's free time
Any mental or physical effort done to produce goods or services
An activity that is only done for money
A punishment given to lazy people

mcq.explanation: Work is any mental or physical effort directed at producing goods or providing services that satisfy human needs.

mcq.questionText: The phrase 'dignity of work' means that:

options.text: Only office jobs deserve respect
Every honest work deserves respect and gives a person value
Manual work is shameful
Work should only be done by adults

mcq.explanation: The dignity of work means all honest labour, whether manual or mental, is worthy of respect and gives a person pride and self-worth.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is an example of self-employment?

options.text: Working as a clerk in a government office
Being employed as a teacher in a public school
Running your own tailoring shop
Working as a driver for a private company

mcq.explanation: Self-employment means creating your own job and working for yourself, such as running your own tailoring business, rather than being employed by someone else.

mcq.questionText: Self-reliance can best be defined as the ability to:

options.text: Depend on others for all your needs
Use your own efforts and resources to meet your needs
Wait for the government to provide everything
Borrow money whenever you need it

mcq.explanation: Self-reliance is the ability to depend on one's own efforts, abilities and resources to satisfy one's needs without relying on others.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a type of skilled work?

options.text: Sweeping a compound
Carrying loads at a market
Repairing a motor vehicle as a trained mechanic
Fetching water from a well

mcq.explanation: Skilled work requires special training or expertise, such as a trained mechanic repairing vehicles, unlike unskilled work which needs little or no training.

mcq.questionText: An entrepreneur is a person who:

options.text: Only buys goods for personal use
Identifies opportunities and starts a business taking risks to make profit
Avoids taking any risks in life
Refuses to create new ideas

mcq.explanation: An entrepreneur identifies business opportunities, takes calculated risks, and organises resources to start and run a business for profit.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a benefit of work to an individual?

options.text: It provides income to meet basic needs
It builds self-respect and confidence
It increases laziness and dependence
It helps a person develop skills and talents

mcq.explanation: Work reduces dependence and laziness; it provides income, builds confidence, and develops skills, so increasing laziness is not a benefit.

mcq.questionText: Why is work important to the nation?

options.text: It increases the number of unemployed people
It produces goods and services that develop the economy
It reduces the country's wealth
It discourages people from being productive

mcq.explanation: Work produces goods and services, creates wealth, and contributes to national income and economic development.

mcq.questionText: Good management of time helps a person to:

options.text: Waste resources and miss deadlines
Complete tasks efficiently and achieve goals
Become disorganised in daily activities
Avoid all forms of planning

mcq.explanation: Managing time well allows a person to plan, complete tasks on time, and achieve goals while avoiding waste.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is a quality of a successful entrepreneur?

options.text: Fear of taking any risk
Creativity and willingness to work hard
Dislike of new ideas
Dependence on others for decisions

mcq.explanation: Successful entrepreneurs are creative, hardworking, confident, and willing to take calculated risks to grow their businesses.

mcq.questionText: Which work is classified as professional work?

options.text: Practising as a qualified doctor or lawyer
Loading goods onto a lorry
Cleaning the streets
Selling fruits informally on the roadside

mcq.explanation: Professional work requires long, formal training and qualifications, such as becoming a doctor or a lawyer.

mcq.questionText: The Tanzanian philosophy of self-reliance encourages citizens to:

options.text: Depend mainly on foreign aid for development
Use local resources and their own efforts to develop themselves and the nation
Avoid all forms of hard work
Wait for help from other countries

mcq.explanation: The philosophy of self-reliance encourages Tanzanians to use their own labour and local resources to bring about development rather than depending on outside help.

mcq.questionText: What is the difference between formal and informal employment?

options.text: Formal employment has no rules while informal does
Formal employment is officially registered with contracts, while informal is unregistered and small-scale
Informal employment always pays more than formal
There is no difference between the two

mcq.explanation: Formal employment is officially recognised with contracts and regulations, while informal employment is small-scale, unregistered, and often without formal contracts.

mcq.questionText: A capital, in the context of starting a business, mainly refers to:

options.text: The number of customers a business has
The money and resources used to start and run the business
The location of the business only
The name given to the business

mcq.explanation: Capital refers to the money, tools, and other resources needed to start and operate a business.

mcq.questionText: Why should young people be encouraged to develop a positive attitude towards work?

options.text: So that they can avoid responsibility
So that they can become productive, self-reliant and contribute to development
So that they can depend entirely on their parents
So that they can despise manual work

mcq.explanation: A positive attitude towards work helps young people become productive and self-reliant citizens who contribute to their own and the nation's development.

fib.questionText: _____ is any mental or physical effort done to produce goods or services.
fib.explanation: Work is the application of mental or physical effort to produce goods or services that satisfy human needs.

fib.questionText: The ability to depend on one's own efforts and resources to meet needs is called _____.
fib.explanation: Self-reliance means using one's own abilities and resources instead of depending on others.

fib.questionText: A person who creates his or her own job and works for themselves is described as being in _____.
fib.explanation: Self-employment means working for oneself by running one's own income-generating activity.

fib.questionText: A person who starts a business and takes risks to make a profit is called an _____.
fib.explanation: An entrepreneur identifies opportunities, takes risks, and organises resources to run a business for profit.

fib.questionText: The money and resources used to start and run a business are known as _____.
fib.explanation: Capital includes the funds, tools, and materials required to establish and operate a business.

fib.questionText: Work that requires special training or expertise is called _____ work.
fib.explanation: Skilled work needs special training or qualifications, unlike unskilled work which requires little training.

fib.questionText: The respect and pride that every honest work gives to a person is called the _____ of work.
fib.explanation: The dignity of work means all honest labour is worthy of respect and gives a person value.

fib.questionText: Using time and resources carefully to avoid waste is known as good _____ of resources.
fib.explanation: Good management of time and resources ensures efficiency and helps achieve goals without waste.

fib.questionText: Employment that is officially registered and operates with contracts and regulations is called _____ employment.
fib.explanation: Formal employment is officially recognised, regulated, and usually involves written contracts.

fib.questionText: The financial gain a business earns after deducting its costs is called _____.
fib.explanation: Profit is the money remaining after a business subtracts its expenses from its total income.

tf.explanation: Entrepreneurs identify opportunities and take calculated risks to run businesses for profit.

tf.questionText: Work provides income that helps a person meet basic needs such as food and shelter.

tf.questionText: Good time management helps a person complete tasks efficiently.
tf.explanation: Managing time well enables a person to plan and finish tasks on time, achieving their goals.

tf.questionText: Self-employment means working for another person or company.
tf.explanation: Self-employment means working for oneself by creating one's own job, not being employed by another.

tf.questionText: Work contributes to national development by producing goods and services.

tf.questionText: Capital is only the customers that a business serves.
tf.explanation: Capital refers to the money and resources used to start and run a business, not its customers.

tf.questionText: The Tanzanian philosophy of self-reliance encourages dependence on foreign aid as the main path to development.

hoq.questionText: A young person finishes school and decides to start a small poultry business instead of waiting for formal employment. Which combination of values does this decision BEST demonstrate?

options.text: Dependence and laziness
Self-reliance, self-employment, and a positive attitude towards work
Fear of risk and avoidance of work
Reliance on foreign aid

hoq.explanation: Starting a business using one's own initiative shows self-reliance, self-employment, and a positive attitude towards work rather than waiting to be employed.

hoq.questionText: Two people earn the same amount of money: one is a registered company accountant with a contract, and the other sells vegetables daily without registration. Which statement correctly distinguishes their employment?

options.text: Both are in informal employment
Both are in formal employment
The accountant is in formal employment while the vegetable seller is in informal employment
The vegetable seller is in formal employment while the accountant is informal

hoq.explanation: Formal employment is registered and governed by contracts, like the accountant's job, while informal employment is unregistered and small-scale, like selling vegetables.

hoq.questionText: A community decides to build a school using its own labour and locally available materials rather than waiting for outside donors. This action MOST directly reflects which principle?

options.text: Dependence on foreign aid
The philosophy of self-reliance
Avoidance of community development
Discouraging the dignity of work

hoq.explanation: Using local labour and resources for development rather than depending on outside donors directly reflects the philosophy of self-reliance.
